sources.fact: LBBD88/YM Phoenix House, 12-14 Wakering Road is 0.42ha, 188 net dwellings and planning-permission-status not-permissioned.
YM provides POINT (0.081229 51.540394) with blank geometry; the point is not the allocation or title polygon.
Ownership-status is not-owned-by-a-public-authority; this does not identify the legal owner or title number.
LBBD's current directory lists Barking Job Centre Plus at Phoenix House, 12-14 Wakering Road, Barking IG11 8QP.
The exact Phoenix House street address matches the Brownfield site address, supporting address-level identity but not a cadastral boundary.
The Regulation 19 Cabinet record lists YM Phoenix House, Wakering Road as a distinct site-allocation document.
Cabinet approved publication/submission steps for the Local Plan; this plan-making decision is not a planning permission for YM.
The LBBD Local Plan 2037 was adopted 18 September 2024 and is the current starting point for planning decisions.
The Development Plan includes the Local Plan and London Plan; allocation remains policy evidence rather than consent.
LBBD states every Brownfield Register site still requires planning permission.
Current borough planning guidance distinguishes site allocations, applications, developer contributions and statutory constraints.
No exact current YM planning application reference was verified in this wave; none is inferred from allocation or current occupancy.

examples.result: YM remains not-permissioned despite adopted allocation status.
188 is allocation/Brownfield capacity, not consented homes.
Current Job Centre use does not prevent future allocation but also does not prove redevelopment has commenced.
Exact address match is not converted into an HMLR title polygon.
Private/non-public ownership status is not an owner-name or title-number field.
Regulation 19 site-allocation provenance is not an application reference.
Blank geometry is not replaced by the address point or a building footprint.
Promotion remains zero until exact current YM application, title relation and statutory overlays are verified.
